```{r Data Frame}

FPspatial <-vect("../Data/Full Profile Data/Spatial/Perry_all_FP_samples.shp") #load spatial data
# Load Perry data and wrangle
data_frame <- read.csv("../Data/Full Profile Data/Final_Perry_FP_data_2025.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")
data_frame <- data_frame %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  rename(id = sample_id_lab,
         hzid = horizon) %>%
  mutate(
    top = as.numeric(sub("-.*", "", to_depth_cm)),
    bottom = as.numeric(str_remove(sub(".*-", "", to_depth_cm), "\\+"))
  )

 
# Define mapping of texture abbrev.
texture_map <- c(
  "LS" = "loamy_sand", "SCL" = "sandy_clay_loam", "SL" = "sandy_loam", "L" = "loam",
  "CL" = "clay_loam", "S" = "sand", "C" = "clay", "SIL" = "silt_loam",
  "SI" = "silt", "SC" = "sandy_clay", "C " = "clay")

# Replace texture abbreviations with full names
data_frame <- data_frame %>%
  mutate(texture = recode(lab_texture_lpsa_preliminary, !!!texture_map),
    color_corrected = gsub("([A-Za-z]+)([0-9]+)", "\\1 \\2", matrix_color),
    hue = sapply(strsplit(as.character(color_corrected), " "), function(x) x[1]),
    value_chroma = sapply(strsplit(as.character(color_corrected), " "), function(x) x[2]),
    value = sapply(strsplit(value_chroma, "/"), function(x) x[1]),
    chroma = sapply(strsplit(value_chroma, "/"), function(x) x[2]),
    color = munsell2rgb(the_hue = hue, the_value = value,  # Split the 'color' column into separate hue, value, and chroma components
    the_chroma = chroma, return_triplets=FALSE),
  )
data_frame$rgb_values <- munsell2rgb(
  the_hue = data_frame$hue,
  the_value = as.numeric(data_frame$value),
  the_chroma = as.numeric(data_frame$chroma),
  return_triplets = TRUE
)

data_frame <- data_frame %>%
  mutate(
    red = rgb_values[, 1],
    green = rgb_values[, 2],
    blue = rgb_values[, 3]
  )
coords <- as.data.frame(terra::crds(FPspatial))  # extracts X and Y
names(coords) <- c("lon", "lat")  # rename to match what `vect()` expects

FPspatial_df <- as.data.frame(FPspatial)
FPspatial_df <- bind_cols(FPspatial_df, coords)

merged_df <- data_frame %>%
  left_join(FPspatial_df %>% select(Point_ID, lon, lat), by = c("point" = "Point_ID"))
names(merged_df)  # should now include "lon" and "lat"

merged_df$lon <- as.numeric(merged_df$lon)
merged_df$lat <- as.numeric(merged_df$lat)
# Remove lat lon rows with NA
merged_df_clean <- merged_df[!is.na(merged_df$lon) & !is.na(merged_df$lat), ]

#pull surface colors:
surface_colors <- merged_df_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat)) %>%
  group_by(point) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

#plot surface colors:
ggplot(surface_colors, aes(x = lon, y = lat)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = color), size = 5) +  # assuming color is the hex string column
  scale_color_identity() +  # tells ggplot to treat the color values as literal hex codes
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Surface Horizon Color") +
  geom_text(aes(label = matrix_color), hjust = -0.2, size = 2)




data_frame <- data_frame %>%
  mutate(
    depletions = ifelse(depletions == "Yes", 1, 0),
    htm = ifelse(htm == "Yes", 1, 0),
    first_letter = str_sub(hzid, 1, 1),  # Extract the first letter
    first_letter_code = case_when(
      first_letter == "A" ~ 1,  # Assign code 1 for horizons starting with "A"
      first_letter == "B" ~ 2,  
      first_letter == "C" ~ 3,  
      first_letter == "E" ~ 4,  
      TRUE ~ 0                  
    ),
    intermingle_body = ifelse(intermingle_body == "Yes", 1, 0),
    concentrations = ifelse(concentrations == "Yes", 1, 0)) %>%
dplyr::select(point, id, hzid, top, bottom, texture, sand, silt, clay, color_corrected, red, green, blue, depletions, concentrations, first_letter_code, htm, intermingle_body) %>% #column selection
arrange(point, id, hzid, top, bottom, texture, clay, sand, silt, color_corrected) #order


# Create a SoilProfileCollection object:
aqp::depths(data_frame) <- point ~ top + bottom
```

```{r Soil Similarity func.}
# Similarity function based on Euclidean distance
calculate_similarity <- function(pedon, series_horizon) {
  sqrt(
    (pedon$sand - series_horizon$sand)^2 +
    (pedon$silt - series_horizon$silt)^2 +
    (pedon$clay - series_horizon$clay)^2)}


```



```{r Soil Series Match}
# Initialize list to store matches
matches <- list()

# Loop through each pedon in your data
for (i in unique(data_frame$id)) {
  # Subset data for the current pedon
  pedon <- data_frame %>% filter(id == i)
  
  # Calculate similarity for each soil series
  similarities <- sapply(osd_data$horizons, function(series_horizon) {
    mean(sapply(1:nrow(pedon), function(j) {
      calculate_similarity(pedon[j, ], series_horizon)
    }), na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  
  # Find the best match
  best_match <- names(which.min(similarities))
  matches[[i]] <- best_match
}

# Create a data frame of matches
matched_series <- data.frame(
  id = names(matches),
  best_match = unlist(matches)
)

print(matched_series)

```

```{r save profiles}
for (profile_point in unique(site(data_frame)$point)) {
  
  # Subset point
  profile_subset <- data_frame[site(data_frame)$point == profile_point, ]
  
  output_file <- file.path("../output/profile_plots", paste0("Profile_Point_", profile_point, ".png"))
  
  # Save plot
  png(filename = output_file, width = 1200, height = 800)
  plotSPC(profile_subset,
          name = "hzid",
          label = "point",
          name.style = 'center-center',
          color = "color",
          cex.names = 1.5, 
          cex.id = 1.5)    
  title(paste("Profile for Point:", profile_point))
  dev.off()
}

cat("done:", output_folder)
```
